root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward growth, sprouting, and emergence, especially in what is planted or produced from the earth, with extensions to other forms of development.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from vegetation and causing growth to cultivation, human and generational development, flourishing, origin, and firm rootedness. These extensions are metaphorical or conventional developments from the central idea of growth.

senses.definition: To grow, sprout, vegetate, or germinate.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the plant grows while bearing or containing oil; the construction describes growth together with an inherent or accompanying property.

senses.definition: To cause plants or vegetation to grow; to produce plant growth.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use, commonly with crops, gardens, trees, vegetation, or other produce of the earth.

senses.definition: To cause a person to grow; to rear or bring someone up.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for human development and upbringing, including the Quranic descriptions of Mary and of humankind being caused to grow from the earth.

senses.definition: Vegetation, plants, or plant growth produced from the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun denotes plant life or vegetative produce broadly, including herbage and the growth of cultivated land.

senses.definition: Growth or rearing; the process of developing and being brought up.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic human contexts, the noun can function as the name of growth or as an expression of a person's good rearing and development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become swollen or protuberant, said of a girl's breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of breast development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to produce or give growth to plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The land is construed as the source or producer of the vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed, nourish, rear, or bring up a child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II development from causing growth, with a child as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plant the term of one's life before one's eyes; to keep one's appointed term constantly in view.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the cited idiomatic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plant a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive cultivation use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sow seed or grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy or girl, for the pubic hair to grow; to become hairy on reaching puberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is a boy or girl, and the specifically mentioned hair is the hair of the pubes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endeavor to make something grow, or to raise it by cultivation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The means may be sowing seed, using date-stones, or planting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression أَهْلُ نَبْتٍ, people of the highest rank or nobility, or people whose property has flourished through their own exertions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression extending growth to social standing or flourishing prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The manner, form, state, or condition in which a thing grows or germinates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the quality or manner of growth rather than to the growing thing itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sugar-candy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later, apparently post-classical designation, noted as probably Persian in origin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vile, contemptible, or despicable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the phrase خَبِيتٌ نَبِيتٌ and may be said of a person or a thing; a variant reading associates it with poverty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ridge raised along the edge of a rivulet or irrigation channel to retain water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural denotes the ridges or side supports of such channels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is fresh or new in anything while it is just growing forth and still small.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or substantival description of newly emerging things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Young offspring or a new generation that grows up alongside an older group and increases its number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also characterize such offspring as evil or undesirable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The manner, condition, or state in which a group's camels, property, or children grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use describing the quality of the growth or development of a group's possessions or descendants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inexperienced young man; in the plural, inexperienced young men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation derived from being newly grown or newly emerged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sect associated with introducing strange innovations in Islam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized historical use of the plural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An origin or lineage from which a person springs; a race or ancestry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively for noble or excellent origin, as in being of an excellent manbit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which plants or herbs grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is مَنَابِتُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of fertile, plant-rich land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant caused to grow or germinate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of a plant that has been made to grow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Firmly rooted or well established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being firmly planted; synonymous with being well rooted or established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The growth or germination of trees or shrubs, including young shoots of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote the vegetation that grows, especially newly emerging or slender growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prickles and branches cut from a palm tree to lighten it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized palm-cultivation term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pieces of a camel's hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use unrelated to the ordinary botanical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for certain species of trees, variously identified with poppy, carob, or thorny trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical identification varies among authorities; the term denotes a botanical species or group rather than a general word for vegetation.

cautions: The Form I Quran occurrence at 23:20 is discussed alongside a reported alternative reading; the public form and example follow the authoritative QAC identification.

For نَبَاتًا in the Quranic human-growth contexts, the evidence records a grammatical difference of interpretation as verbal noun versus circumstantial expression; both support the listed growth/rearing sense.
